title: The actual principal comparison and fractional contribution
objective: Connect the supported centered polynomial energy to the actual cofactor comparison on the honest balanced arithmetic input, retaining the nonzero principal term and identifying what it implies about fractional compensation without assuming a raw-count lower bound.
deliverables: At most two exact comparison claims
A positive main term or precise first falsifier
success_criteria: Positivity is proved only on its actual input class
Nonprincipal energy is connected through exact transforms with paid tails
The principal term is not identified with an unknown prime-pair count
The original signed difference and pointwise prime margin remain explicit
stop_conditions: One pair round within8 proxy units
No paid inference, publication or external messages
A nonzero major comparison alone does not complete the Goldbach objective
